title: Email Template Layout
content: Build responsive HTML email template. Constraints: table-based layout for email client compatibility, inline styles. Structure: outer table for centering, inner table for content. Header: logo centered. Body: headline, paragraphs, CTA button, images. Footer: social links, unsubscribe link, company address. Max-width 600px. Mobile-responsive with media queries where supported.

variants.simple: Create HTML email template with header, content, and footer.
variants.detailed: Build responsive HTML email template. Constraints: table-based layout for email client compatibility, inline styles. Structure: outer table for centering, inner table for content. Header: logo centered. Body: headline, paragraphs, CTA button, images. Footer: social links, unsubscribe link, company address. Max-width 600px. Mobile-responsive with media queries where supported.
variants.advanced: Build responsive HTML email template compatible with major email clients. Constraints: table-based layout (no flexbox/grid), inline CSS styles (or style tag for progressive enhancement), no external stylesheets, max-width 600px, MSO conditionals for Outlook. Outer structure: center-aligned wrapper table (width 100%, bgcolor background color). Inner container table: width 600px, centered with align="center", bgcolor white. Header section: table row with logo image (max-width for retina: width="200" style="width:200px;max-width:100%"), centered. Preheader text: hidden preview text (font-size:0;line-height:0;display:none). Body content: padding via table cells (cellpadding or nested table with width). Headline: inline styles (font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; color: #333;). Paragraphs: inline styles (font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #666;), mso-line-height-rule:exactly for Outlook. CTA button: table-based button for full client support. Outer table: cellpadding for padding, bgcolor for button color, border-radius via CSS (won't work everywhere). Inner td: padding, link styled as text (no underline). Bulletproof button: VML for Outlook fallback. Images: always include width, height, alt, border="0", style="display:block" to prevent gaps. Hero image: full-width with max-width:100%. Two-column layout: nested table with two td cells, stack on mobile using media query @media (max-width: 599px) with display:block and width:100% !important. Footer section: smaller text (font-size: 12px; color: #999;). Social icons: inline images linked. Unsubscribe link: required, clear text. Company address: required for CAN-SPAM. Media queries: in style tag for clients that support it, reset widths to 100% for mobile stack, increase font sizes for readability. Dark mode: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) support where available, test with fallbacks. Testing: test in Litmus or Email on Acid across clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo). Template variants: transactional (order confirmation, password reset), marketing (newsletter, promotion), notification.
